topic: Why zero-cost EMI is not always a free decision
central_idea: No-cost EMI does not remove interest; it moves the cost into the product price, a lost cash discount, or a processing fee, which is what RBI flagged when it called zero percent interest non-existent in 2013.
engagement_goal: Saves and shares: a checkout checklist plus a surprising regulatory fact
